problem:
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/differential/14164726/assets/dfcaa1de127881d7f6291efa2f78fbaecf1e5e29cea00d6b071c6ed2b800026f.png)

What is the range of the function $g$ defined by the mapping diagram shown above?
worked_solution:
The range of $g(x)$ consists of all the outputs that have a corresponding $x$-input.

In a mapping diagram, the range consists of all the outputs to which an arrow is drawn.

Therefore, the range is the set $\{-\frac{5}{2},0,2,6\}.$
